reviewed_by: Automated static review (Radare2 0x0048F530..0x0048F970 + Binary Ninja CFG; 2026-10-23 re-review of the startup body)
scope_note: This review covers the startup order and the per-frame loop the MVP transcription keeps. The retail main also runs a DirectX version check, a script setup, about twenty startup getter/registration calls and the movie, particle, debug-key, sound and joystick backends; those are enumerated in the implementation's Status/limits and are not claimed by this review.

checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: Radare2 and Binary Ninja both identify a single function entry at 0x0048F530 (26 blocks, 37 edges, recorded similarity 1.000), and this unit implements that entry as Main.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: Retail takes the WinMain triple (HINSTANCE, int show command, char* command line) on the stack; the port carries instance and show_command in RetailMainConfig and consumes them for RegisterClassExW, CreateWindowExW and ShowWindow.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.rationale: The transcribed window creation uses the retail 640x480 size and window styles, the 0x7F00 icon and cursor resource id, the 500 ms idle sleep and the x87 extended-precision setup the retail loop performs.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.rationale: The startup body reads no packed retail structure; the WNDCLASSEX and MSG records it fills are the Win32 ABI's own and are populated field by field.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.rationale: Within the transcribed scope the calls are the retail's in the retail's order: mutex, COM initialisation, class registration with the 0x0048F970 procedure, window creation, show and update, then the per-frame loop. The skipped startup calls are listed in the implementation's Status/limits and are not claimed.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: Each retail failure branch - null mutex, mutex already held, class registration failure, window creation failure - returns 1, and the WM_QUIT exit returns 0, as the retail code does.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.rationale: The transcribed loop only loads the x87 control word to set extended precision; it performs no floating-point arithmetic in this scope.

limitations: The executable's actual entry point is engine/main.cpp, which registers the retail "Innerloop" class; this unit's Main is a second transcription that registers "IGI" and is not the entry the built candidate runs. The two have not been reconciled.
The mutex name is IGI2MUTEX rather than the retail IGIMUTEX, a deliberate tooling divergence for paired observation, not a fidelity claim.
